9A.15.eg: Hatch cover hydraulic oil analysed regularly.

9A.20.eg: Crane machinery & cab: limit switches, emergency stop, controls, cleanliness.

9A.20.fg: Crane machinery at cab: limit switches, emergency stop, controls, kalinisan.
fc: Gumagana ang limit switches (hoist, luff, slew) at overload; emergency stop

May markang SWL sa jib
fx: Maayos ang machinery at cab ng cranes, may tests ayon sa maker.
Sira ang limit switches o controls
ff: Hindi gumagana ang limit switch o emergency stop
Marumi ang cab, sira ang wiper, walang extinguisher

9A.21.eg: Grabs maintained per maker, in the PMS.

10.1.eg: Mooring Line Management Plan (MEG4/INTERTANKO) and it is applied (inspections, rotation).

Does random checks on the plan
10.1.fg: Mooring Line Management Plan (MEG4/INTERTANKO) at ipinapatupad (inspections, rotation).
fc: MLMP ayon sa MEG4 / INTERTANKO section 2: retirement criteria, inspection intervals
Line records: inspections, end-for-end, rotation, oras/gamit
Patunay na ipinapatupad ang plan (hindi lang sa papel)

Hindi sakop ng Mooring Line Management Plan ang INTERTANKO section 2
ff: Hindi ipinapatupad ang mooring line management plan – walang inspection, rotation, end-for-end records
Hindi sinusunod ang retirement criteria
Kulang sa dalawa ang spare mooring lines

fc: Certificate ng bawat line/tail (tugma ang ID tags)
fx: May certificates ang lines at tails.
ff: Walang line / tail certificates o hindi tugma ang ID tags

Tails TDBF ≥125% ng MBL
Ang HMPE lines ay DAPAT may tails
Walang gasgas/sirang lines
fx: Lines at tails ayon sa industry guidelines at maayos.
Line (o spare) na LDBF ay mas mababa sa 100% ng MBL
Tail na TDBF ay mas mababa sa 125%
ff: Line LDBF <100% ng ship design MBL, tail TDBF <125%
May gasgas / sira ang lines, HMPE na walang tails
Magkaibang uri ng line sa parehong lead

10.5.eg: Winch brake rendering test (annual) and records.
ex: Brake rendering test procedure, and the test is done.

fx: May procedure sa brake rendering test, at ginagawa ito.

Mahigpit ang brakes, out of gear ang winches
fx: Tama ang pagkakarolyo ng lines sa drums, sarado ang brakes, out of gear ang winches.

Higit sa 1 ikot sa tension drum

10.12.fg: Heaving lines na may monkey's fist o soft pouch ≤0.5 kg, walang pabigat sa loob.

May pabigat o metal sa loob

Hindi madulas ang sahig, maliwanag, walang langis
